name: Portugal
description: Portugal from the Lusitanians and Rome to the founding kingdom, the age of discovery, the earthquake of 1755, the republic, the Carnation Revolution and Europe.

checkpoints.name: Before Portugal
checkpoints.note: The Lusitanians fought Rome, and the land became the province of Lusitania. Visigoths and then Moors ruled.

checkpoints.name: The kingdom
checkpoints.note: Afonso I made Portugal a kingdom, took Lisbon in 1147, and his heirs completed the conquest of the south.

checkpoints.name: Discoveries and empire
checkpoints.note: Portuguese ships went down the coast of Africa, reached India in 1498 and Brazil in 1500, and built an empire of trade.

checkpoints.name: Earthquake to dictatorship
checkpoints.note: The earthquake of 1755 destroyed Lisbon. Brazil became independent in 1822, the monarchy fell in 1910, and Salazar ruled for decades.

checkpoints.name: Democracy
checkpoints.note: The Carnation Revolution of 1974 ended the dictatorship and the empire. Portugal joined Europe in 1986.
